mapper.select: select c.id, c.parent_id as parentId, cc.content, c.like_num as likeNum, c.reply_num as replyNum, c.create_time as createTime, cc.pic_url as picUrl, c.score from cms_comment c left join cms_comment_content cc on c.content_id = cc.id where c.parent_id = #{parentId} order by createTime desc

select c.id, c.parent_id as parentId, cc.content, c.like_num as likeNum, c.reply_num as replyNum, cc.pic_url as picUrl, c.score from cms_comment c left join cms_comment_content cc on c.content_id = cc.id
where c.parent_id = 0 and c.good_id = #{goodId} order by c.score desc limit #{offset},#{pageSize}
mapper.insert: insert into cms_comment (parent_id, score, user_id, content_id, good_id) value ( #{comment.parentId}, #{comment.score}, #{comment.userId}, #{comment.goodId} )
